dct_creator_sm: Hunter, Miranda (University of Waterloo). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0002-2989-5998
dct_description_sm: Data files are associated with a publication submitted to Biogeosciences titled "Ecosystem-scale greenhouse gas emissions from actively extracted peatlands: water table depth drives interannual variability".

This dataset contains ecosystem scale carbon dioxide and methane emissions, along with associated environmental and meteorological variables, from an actively extracted peatland in Alberta and Quebec Canada. The data was collected using the eddy covariance technique. Data was collected from multiple years at each site, spanning from 2020 to 2022.
dct_title_s: Ecosystem scale carbon dioxide and methane emissions from extracted peatlands in Alberta and Quebec, Canada
